name: AI Grammatic
summary: Rewrites selected text anywhere on a Mac with one shortcut, for grammar, tone and translation.
description: AI Grammatic (also called GrammaticAI) is a macOS writing assistant: you select text anywhere and press ⌘⌥E to rewrite it for grammar, tone or translation. The product is Mac-only.

pricing.details: 7 days free, then 7 €/month or 53 €/year. Mac only.
